author: (Pourtalès, 1874)

note.en: A small solitary cup coral without algae, collected only once, from the outer crest of the Cahuita reef, by Cortés in 1992.
note.es: Un pequeño coral copa solitario sin algas, recolectado solo una vez, en la cresta externa del arrecife de Cahuita, por Cortés en 1992.

evidence: Cortés 1992 (Rev. Biol. Trop. 40, new records for Caribbean Costa Rica): one specimen from the outer crest at Cahuita; Cortés 1996-97: UCR 122

sources.t: Cortés 1996-97, Biodiversidad marina de Costa Rica: Filo Cnidaria, Revista de Biología Tropical 44(3)/45(1)
WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species

recWhy: Recorded: Cortés 1992 (Rev. Biol. Trop. 40, new records for Caribbean Costa Rica): one specimen from the outer crest at Cahuita; Cortés 1996-97: UCR 122.

marks.en: Small solitary cup-shaped stony coral with a ridged cup and tentacles often out at night.
marks.es: Coral pétreo solitario pequeño en forma de copa con paredes estriadas y tentáculos a menudo extendidos de noche.
